per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The UI must be quick and obvious so that users can perform basic tasks without training; a typical first-time user should be able to complete a simple room booking within about five minutes.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall be easy to use. 90% of users will be able to successfully reserve a conference room within 5 minutes of product use.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The product must support customer-specific branding: allow customer logo, color palette and limited font choices so the application appears as an official tool for that customer while preventing themes that break accessibility or usability.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: The product's Look and Feel shall be able to incorporate aspects of the customer's organization such as logo branding and identity'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system must integrate with customer mail infrastructure (Exchange, Google/Gmail, and standard SMTP) so calendar invites and notifications are delivered to recipients.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product must be able to interface with various email servers. The product shall be able to send email.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system must capture exceptions and delivery failures in logs and automatically and securely transmit those logs to the vendor's analysis pipeline for support and diagnostics.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall create an exception log of problems encountered within the product for transmission to our company for analysis and resolution.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Log transmission of exceptions must be automatic and secure — the system should package exceptions and securely transmit them to the customer's/vendor's analysis pipeline without manual export.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall create an exception log of problems encountered within the product for transmission to our company for analysis and resolution.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The application must handle predictable peak load spikes (e.g., right before the workday and just after lunch) without perceptible slowdown to users.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall be capable of handling up to 1 000 concurrent requests. This number will increase to 2 000 by Release 2. The concurrency capacity must be able to handle peak scheduling times such as early morning and late afternoon hours.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The product must support approximately 1,000 concurrent requests initially and be designed to scale to about 2,000 concurrent requests in the next release.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall be capable of handling up to 1 000 concurrent requests. This number will increase to 2 000 by Release 2. The concurrency capacity must be able to handle peak scheduling times such as early morning and late afternoon hours.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: For common interactions (e.g., room search, saving a booking), about 90% of routine tasks must complete within roughly five seconds, and approximately 98% must complete within eight seconds.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: The response shall be fast enough to avoid interrupting the user's flow of thought. 90% of tasks shall complete within 5 seconds. 98% of tasks shall complete within 8 seconds.'
